builds.name: Elemental Lava Burst (PvP)
builds.summary: Elemental with Lava Burst, Lightning Overload, Elemental Fury, Earthbound and Eye of the Storm; Thundering Strikes and Ancestral Knowledge from Enhancement. The community's caster standard.

builds.name: Enhancement (PvE)
builds.summary: Enhancement build #1's Stormstrike core with Totemic Focus and Tidal Focus from Restoration in place of Call of Flame, Reverberation and Improved Fire Nova: cheaper totems and heals for leveling.

builds.name: Enhancement Stormstrike (PvP)
builds.summary: Enhancement with Stormstrike, Maelstrom Weapon, Flurry, Spirit Weapons and Rage of the Farseer; Concussion, Call of Flame and Reverberation from Elemental for shock burst. The community's PvP standard.

builds.name: Restoration Riptide (PvE)
builds.summary: Restoration with Riptide, Mana Tide Totem, Nature's Swiftness and Purification; Thundering Strikes and Ancestral Knowledge from Enhancement. The most saved shaman build: the community's healer standard (routes only, unscored).

caveats: Elemental (#167): Flame Shock kept up, Lava Burst and Chain Lightning on cooldown, Lightning Bolt in between on the caster engine. Enhancement (#175): two-hander swings with Windfury (Classic chance and attack power) and Flurry, Stormstrike and Earth Shock on cooldown on the melee engine; Stormstrike's debuff, Maelstrom Weapon, totems and Enhancement's mana aren't modeled. Restoration stays unscored. Base stats are estimates.
